enchantment.wsee.sword_aura.desc: Release a frontal sword wave on swing or hit.; I-V range: 6/7/8/9/10 blocks.
enchantment.wsee.shield_bash.desc: Bash targets in a frontal arc while blocking.; 50-tick cooldown; air swings also start it.
enchantment.wsee.deflect.desc: Reflect normal, tipped, or spectral arrows.; Facing direction; speed x0.90, damage x0.80.
enchantment.wsee.expansion.desc: Load multiple crossbow arrows at once.; Fire them in quick succession.; Each extra arrow follows your current aim when fired.
enchantment.wsee.cluster.desc: Fire several tightly grouped arrows.; Each arrow deals reduced damage and resolves normally.
enchantment.wsee.armor_piercing.desc: Reduce the target's effective armor.; Improve crossbow damage against armored targets.
enchantment.wsee.bleeding.desc: Direct spear hits apply bleeding.; Damage still respects armor and Protection.
enchantment.wsee.long_edge.desc: Increase the distance at which a spear can attack entities.
enchantment.wsee.surge.desc: A thrown trident charges after water flight.; I/II/III: 6/5/4 water ticks.; Damage x1.15/1.25/1.35.
enchantment.wsee.tether.desc: A thrown trident pulls a directly hit target toward you.
enchantment.wsee.rebound.desc: A Loyal trident can damage entities again while returning.
enchantment.wsee.hydroshock.desc: A thrown trident impact in water creates a shockwave.; Pushes nearby creatures away; no melee trigger.
enchantment.wsee.overcharge.desc: Hold a fully drawn bow longer to charge arrows.; I/II/III damage +7%/+17%/+27%.; Speed +5%/+8%/+12%.
enchantment.wsee.combo_strike.desc: Consecutive hits on one target build a combo.; The next hit becomes the finisher at full charge.
enchantment.wsee.explosive_arrow.desc: Arrows hitting entities or blocks detonate after a delay.; Area damage is based on the shooter's attack power.
enchantment.wsee.battle_momentum.desc: Successful direct melee hits build momentum.; Independent damage sources do not add stacks.
enchantment.wsee.forced_march.desc: Ground sprinting grants movement speed.; The bonus lasts 15 ticks after stopping.
enchantment.wsee.clarity.desc: While worn, blocks Darkness, Blindness, and Nausea.
enchantment.wsee.execution.desc: Axes deal bonus damage before defense.; Triggers at health plus absorption <= 30% max health.
enchantment.wsee.falling_star.desc: A high-altitude mace smash applies area Slowness.; I/II/III: radius 3/4/5 blocks; requires at least 4 blocks of fall distance.
enchantment.wsee.shock_ring.desc: A falling mace smash releases an expanding shock ring.; I/II/III: radius 3/4/5.; Damage 12%/16%/20%; knocks targets back.
enchantment.wsee.shield.desc: Periodically grants vanilla Absorption.; I-V: 8%/12%/16%/20%/25% max health.; Refreshes every 4800 ticks.
enchantment.wsee.holy_light.desc: At 20% max health, heal yourself for 15 seconds.; Every 20 ticks, restore health.; I/II/III: 2%/2.5%/3% max health.
enchantment.wsee.tracking.desc: At 80% draw, lock one nearby target.; Gently correct flight without changing damage or speed.
enchantment.wsee.refining.desc: Ore-tagged blocks with a smelting recipe drop the smelted result directly.; Fortune quantities are preserved.
enchantment.wsee.arrow_rain.desc: At 90% draw, an impact calls down arrow rain.; 10-tick warning; lasts 30/36/40 ticks.
enchantment.wsee.frostbite.desc: Direct sword or spear hits add vanilla freezing.; Also apply Slowness for 40/60/60 ticks.
enchantment.wsee.foundation.desc: Enchanted leggings increase knockback resistance.; I/II/III: +0.15/+0.25/+0.35.
enchantment.wsee.air_force.desc: Successful fishing yields exactly one non-fish item.
enchantment.wsee.flying_hook.desc: Accelerate the hook with no drop in flight.; Any block face or entity anchors it and automatically pulls you in.
enchantment.wsee.double_jump.desc: Jump once more after leaving the ground.; Gain two extra blocks of safe fall height.
commands.wsee.reset_cooldown.player_only: This command can only be used by a player.
commands.wsee.reset_cooldown.unknown: Unknown enchantment cooldown. Use shield, holy_light, or shield_bash.
